newsitem.title: UK: UK confectioner Thorntons has record sales.
newsitem.headline: UK confectioner Thorntons has record sales.

text.p: British chocolate maker Thorntons Plc on Thursday reported record sales of 109.2 million stg in the year to June 28, an increase of 19.1 pct year-on-year.

Thorntons said it's sales were strong at all the second half seasons -- Valentine's Day, Mother's Day, Easter and Father's Day -- while day-to-day sales benefited from the launch of 27 new countline bars, along with "Choccies" cookies and the relaunch of ice-cream.
Own shop sales were up 27.5 pct in the full year, with 30.3 pct growth in the second half.

"We're particularly encouraged by our customers' positive response to the 157 new look shops opened in the year and by the success of the new product launches aimed at boosting our all year round appeal," Thorntons' chief executive Roger Paffard said in a statement.
